No front door

Followers stay followers

A woman can quietly save your posts for months while she finds her footing, and never join an email list. Every month without a class capturing emails is trust you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Bookings start from zero

Someone can go from one reel to your calendar with no idea how you work. A class lets her experience your approach first, gently and at her own pace, so the women who apply already feel safe with you.

Content treadmill

1,588 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post. When you take a week off to rest, the enquiries take a week off too.

The women who find comfort in your content but aren't ready for 1:1 today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A £17 masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills your 1:1 diary

You already have the audience and the expertise. What's missing is one low-cost, 90-minute class that explains your trauma-informed, somatic approach to rebuilding after emotional abuse, offers a practice kit after checkout, and invites the right women to apply for 1:1 coaching. Meta ads then put that class in front of new women every day.

Fixes the missing front door

One class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every buyer is an email you own, and every woman sees how you work before you ask for anything bigger.

Fixes the missing qualifier

A paid seat means people show up. The replay page invites women who want deeper support to apply, so you only speak to people who watched, stayed and told you what they need.

Pays for the ads

£17 seats and the [£37] Steady Ground Kit bring revenue in on the front end, so the cost of reaching new women is largely covered before anyone books a call.

The 95%*

Not ready for 1:1 yet

They buy a £17 seat, many add the Steady Ground Kit, and keep learning from your emails and content at their own pace. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for deeper support

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application checks for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails help them arrive feeling settled and prepared.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Sound familiar?

Leaving was step one. Feeling steady again is the next.

  • You've left a controlling or emotionally abusive relationship, and the hardest part has been everything that came after.
  • You still feel confused, on edge or doubt yourself, long after the relationship ended.
  • You understand what happened, yet your body still doesn't feel safe.
  • You want to hear your own voice again and make decisions that feel like yours.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll explore together in 90 minutes

01

Why the fog lingers

Why so many women still feel confused, on edge or doubt themselves long after a relationship has ended.

02

What the body holds

A trauma-informed look at the nervous system, and why insight alone often isn't enough to feel safe again.

03

Three somatic practices

Simple grounding practices you can use in a few minutes, on a hard day, wherever you are.

04

Rebuilding self-trust

How to start hearing your own voice again, and making small decisions that feel like yours.

05

Your next step

How 1:1 coaching with Lorna works, so you can decide, in your own time, what support fits you.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Who is this for?

Women who have left a controlling or emotionally abusive relationship and want to understand what their body has been holding, and how to start feeling steady again.

What if I can't make it live?

Your seat includes the replay for 48 hours, so you can watch it in your own time.

Do I have to be on camera or speak?

No. Camera off is welcome, and questions for the live Q&A can be sent anonymously.

What does my £17 seat include?

The 90-minute live masterclass with Lorna, a 10-minute grounding practice audio, the live Q&A and the 48-hour replay.

Is this therapy?

No. This is educational coaching content, not therapy or medical advice. If you are in danger, please contact emergency services or a domestic abuse helpline.

What happens after the class?

Lorna explains how 1:1 coaching with her works, so you can decide, in your own time, what support fits you.

Educational coaching content, not therapy or medical advice. If you are in danger, please contact emergency services or a domestic abuse helpline.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The part nobody talks about"

Hook
"So many women tell me the hardest part wasn't leaving. It was everything that came after." (to camera, soft natural light, the same warm look as your profile)
Body
"The self-doubt. The jumpiness. Replaying conversations at 2am. That's often the nervous system still doing its job, long after the danger has passed. Understanding it is a start, and gentle body-based practices can help it settle." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach this in a 90-minute class called Finding Your Way Back to You. It's £17, and camera off is welcome. Tap Sign up to save a seat. Educational coaching content, not therapy."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"A two-minute grounding practice"

Hook
"Here's a two-minute practice I share with women rebuilding after a hard relationship." (Lorna seated, calm, hands resting)
Body
"Feel your feet on the floor. Name three things you can see. Let your out-breath be a little longer than your in-breath. Small, simple, and something anyone can do on a hard day." (caption for each step)
CTA
"I share more practices like this in my £17 masterclass. Link below. Educational coaching content, not therapy."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"Women often ask me where to start if they're thinking about working with me. Here's my honest answer." (walking outdoors, natural light)
Body
"Start with my class. In 90 minutes you'll understand my trauma-informed approach, try a few somatic practices, and get a feel for whether 1:1 coaching is the right next step, with no pressure at all."
CTA
"It's called Finding Your Way Back to You, it's £17, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
